files_page_intro: The working folder of «%1$s»: the folders its conversations and tasks work in. A file manager only — nothing here runs a command.
files_page_empty_body: Use Upload, New folder or New file.
files_page_truncated: This folder holds more than 5000 items; only the first 5000 are listed.
files_page_limits: Limits: upload %1$s per file · edit %2$s · zip %3$s.
files_page_upload_too_large: %1$s is larger than this hub takes (%2$s).
files_page_upload_unreadable: %1$s could not be read on this phone.
files_page_replace_body: A file with this name is already in this folder. Replacing it cannot be undone.
files_page_destination_hint: Inside this profile's files, for example reports/2026/plan.md. The folder must exist.
files_page_delete_body: The file is removed from the profile's folder. This cannot be undone.
files_page_delete_folder_body: The folder and everything in it are removed from the profile's folder. This cannot be undone.
files_page_link_outside_hint: This link points outside the profile's files, so it cannot be opened here.
files_page_not_allowed: Only the owner and admins can manage this profile's files.
files_page_exists: Something with that name is already there.
files_page_too_large: That is larger than this hub allows.
files_page_not_text: This file is not plain text; open or share it instead.
files_page_outside: That path is outside this profile's files.
files_page_root_refused: The top folder itself cannot be changed.
files_page_into_itself: A folder cannot go inside itself.
files_page_gone: It is not there any more.
files_page_attach_body: The hub copies the file into the chat: it waits in the composer, ready to go with your next message. Later edits here do not change what was attached.
files_page_attach_none: No chats in this profile yet.
